Starts the workflow on the trades of the traders you follow as they happen, about two seconds after: a trade each item, its fills summed.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | `trigger.walletActivity` |
| Kind | Trigger: starts executions |
| Outputs | `main` |

## Settings

| Setting | Kind | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Traders (`traders`) | table, its columns below | yes |  | A row a trader: their trades start the workflow while their row is on. |
| Sides (`sides`) | list of text | no | `buy`, `sell` | One of `buy`, `sell`. |
| At least $ (`least`) | number | no | `0` | Trades worth fewer dollars are skipped. |
| Catch up within (`catchUp`) | duration, e.g. `30s`, `5m`, `1h` | no | `2m` | After the server restarts or the trade stream drops, trades missed meanwhile still start the workflow if they are younger than this, up to an hour; older ones are skipped. |

### Traders columns

Each row of **Traders** has these cells.

| Column | Kind | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Label (`label`) | text | yes |  | Who they are to you. |
| Address (`address`) | address: `0x` and 40 hex digits | yes |  | Their Polymarket wallet: the address in their profile's link. |
| On (`on`) | true or false | no | `true` | Off, their trades are not followed. |
| Size × (`scale`) | number | no |  | Scales what Copy sizing works out for their trades; empty is 1. |
| Max $ (`maxDollars`) | number | no |  | The most dollars a copy of one of their trades may spend; empty leaves it to the Risk guard. |

## Items

Each item has these fields. Decimals are text, so they stay exact; times are RFC 3339 text.

| Field | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `trader` | object | Whose trade it is: their row of Traders. |
| `trader.label` | text | Their label. |
| `trader.address` | text | Their wallet. |
| `trader.name` | text; or null | Their name on Polymarket. |
| `trader.scale` | decimal; or null | Size ×: what Copy sizing works out is scaled by it. |
| `trader.maxDollars` | decimal; or null | Max $: the most a copy may spend. |
| `side` | text, one of `buy`, `sell` | Whether they bought or sold. |
| `role` | text, one of `taker`, `maker`; or null | taker: their order met the book; maker: a resting order of theirs filled. Null when the source did not say. |
| `tokenId` | text | The outcome's token ID. |
| `marketId` | text; or null | The market's condition ID. |
| `question` | text; or null | The market's question. |
| `outcome` | text; or null | The outcome, like Yes. |
| `slug` | text; or null | The market's slug. |
| `eventSlug` | text; or null | Its event's slug. |
| `shares` | decimal | Shares traded, all its fills together. |
| `price` | decimal | The average price per share. |
| `dollars` | decimal | Dollars traded: shares times their prices. |
| `fills` | number | How many fills it took. |
| `txHash` | text | The transaction. |
| `at` | time | When it happened. |
